Visit 2 Eligibility Confirmation
data.description: Screening laboratory results reviewed at Visit 2 to confirm eligibility; Visit 2 may occur as soon as criteria for Visit 1 are confirmed
data.text: At Visit 2, screening laboratory results will be reviewed to confirm eligibility. Visit 2 may occur as soon as the criteria for Visit 1 are confirmed.

data.name: Pre-Randomization Eligibility Confirmation
data.description: Inclusion and exclusion criteria must be confirmed prior to randomization and administration of first dose
data.text: Confirm inclusion and exclusion criteria prior to randomization and administration of first dose of study intervention.

data.name: HbA1c Entry Criterion
data.description: Central laboratory HbA1c range required at Visit 1
data.text: HbA1c ≥7.0% (53 mmol/mol) to ≤9.5% (80 mmol/mol), as determined by the central laboratory at Visit 1 (screening).

data.name: Antihyperglycemic Medication Naive Condition
data.description: No oral or injectable antihyperglycemic medications during 90 days preceding Visit 1 or between Visit 1 and Visit 3; insulin naive except gestational diabetes or ≤14 days acute use
data.text: Are naïve to insulin therapy except for gestational diabetes or ≤14 days use for acute treatment and have not used any oral or injectable antihyperglycemic medications during the 90 days preceding Visit 1, or between Visit 1 and Visit 3 (randomization).

data.name: Age and Diagnosis Condition
data.description: Minimum age and T2D diagnosis requirement
data.text: At least 18 years of age or the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction, whichever is older; clinical diagnosis of T2D based on WHO classification or other locally applicable diagnostic standards.

data.name: Retinopathy Eligibility Confirmation
data.description: Eligibility per exclusion criterion 13 must be confirmed based on fundus photographs and any additional ophthalmological evaluation
data.text: Eligibility (see exclusion criterion 13) MUST be confirmed based on fundus photographs and any additional ophthalmological evaluation needed.

data.name: Baseline Retinopathy/DME Present
data.description: Condition triggering follow-up fundus photography at Week 24
data.text: Perform follow-up fundus photography and any additional ophthalmological evaluation at Week 24 (±4 weeks) only if retinopathy or DME were present at baseline.

data.name: Pregnancy Test Result Before First Dose
data.description: For WOCBP, urine pregnancy test result must be available before first dose
data.text: The result must be available before the first dose of study intervention for WOCBP. Perform additional pregnancy tests if a menstrual period is missed, if there is clinical suspicion of pregnancy, or as required by local law or regulation.

data.name: Fasting State Condition for Fasting Visits
data.description: Participant must be fasting at least 8 hours and not take study intervention before the fasting visit
data.text: On all fasting visits, study participants are required to report to the site in a fasting condition, after at least 8 hours without eating, drinking (except water), or performing any significant physical activity. Additionally, the participant should not take their study intervention before the fasting visit.

data.name: Hepatic Laboratory Criteria for Interruption/Discontinuation
data.description: Laboratory criteria for study drug interruption/discontinuation in participants with elevated baseline hepatic values
data.text: ALT or AST ≥2x baseline or ≥250 U/L (whichever occurs first) and TBL ≥2x ULN or INR ≥1.5.

data.name: BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or Perceived Excessive Weight Reduction
data.description: Condition triggering dose modification and monitoring of weight after dose reduction
data.text: Management of participants with BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or perceived excessive weight reduction; recommendation for monitoring weight after dose reduction for BMI ≤20 kg/m2.

data.name: Poor Nutrition or Dehydration
data.description: Condition triggering dose modification, management per Appendix 11, or discontinuation
data.text: Option of dose modification for participants with poor nutrition or dehydration; new discontinuation criterion added to facilitate the management of participants with poor nutrition or dehydration.

data.name: Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia
data.description: Condition triggering rescue therapy
data.text: Rescue Therapy for Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia (Section 6.9.4).

data.name: Gastrointestinal Tolerability
data.description: GI tolerability drives dose modification; temporary interruption may also occur unrelated to GI tolerability
data.text: Dose modification for gastrointestinal tolerability; temporary interruption of study intervention unrelated to gastrointestinal tolerability (Section 6.6.4).

data.name: Pregnancy During Study
data.description: Any female participant who becomes pregnant will discontinue study intervention and be withdrawn from the study
data.text: Any female participant who becomes pregnant while participating in the study will discontinue study intervention and will be withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Safety Follow-up Visit Waiver Condition
data.description: Participants who discontinued study intervention early and only willing to return for Visit 11 are not required to complete safety follow-up if off intervention ≥28 days
data.text: Participants who have discontinued study intervention early and are only willing to come back for Visit 11 (Week 40) are not required to complete a safety follow-up visit if they have been off of study intervention for at least 28 days.

data.name: Non-Fasting Attendance at Fasting Visit
data.description: Visit must be rescheduled within the allowable visit interval
data.text: If a participant attends a fasting visit in the non-fasting state, reschedule the visit at a time within the allowable visit interval.

data.name: Visit Conduct Over Multiple Days
data.description: Visit procedures may span more than 1 day if within visit tolerance
data.text: Visit procedures may be conducted over more than 1 day if all activities are completed within the allowed visit tolerance period of each visit.

data.name: Prohibited Injectable/Implantable Contraceptive Condition
data.description: Prohibited unless initiated and used continuously for at least 18 months prior to study entry
data.text: The use of subcutaneous/intramuscular or implantable/injectable contraceptives is prohibited except when initiated and used continuously for at least 18 months prior to study entry.

data.name: Hepatic Monitoring Stabilization Condition
data.description: Frequency of close hepatic monitoring may be reduced if clinical condition and labs stabilize
data.text: Subsequently, the frequency of monitoring may be lowered to once every 1 to 2 weeks, if the participant's clinical condition and lab results stabilize.

data.name: Unscheduled Immunogenicity Sampling Condition
data.description: Additional unscheduled samples collected for hypersensitivity or injection site reactions
data.text: Collect additional unscheduled samples if systemic drug hypersensitivity reactions (immediate or nonimmediate) or injection site reactions occur (severe or recurrent).

data.name: Exceptional Circumstances Condition
data.description: Alternative SoA guidance for participants affected by pandemics or natural disasters
data.text: For those participants whose participation in this study is affected by exceptional circumstances, such as pandemics or natural disasters, refer to Section 10.14 for additional guidance.

data.name: Screening (Period I) to Treatment (Period II) Transition
data.text: Confirm inclusion and exclusion criteria prior to randomization and administration of first dose at Visit 3; Visit 3 to occur no sooner than 18 days after Visit 1 (screening up to 4 weeks). Randomization via IWRS in a 1:1:1:1 ratio to retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, 12 mg, or placebo.

data.name: Visit 1 to Visit 2 Transition
data.text: Visit 2 may occur as soon as the criteria for Visit 1 are confirmed; screening laboratory results reviewed at Visit 2 to confirm eligibility.

data.name: Treatment Period to Safety Follow-up Transition
data.text: A posttreatment safety follow-up visit (Visit 801) will occur approximately 4 weeks following the last treatment period visit (Visit 11, Week 40).

data.name: Permanent Discontinuation from Study Intervention
data.text: Permanent discontinuation from study intervention per Section 7.1.1, including a discontinuation criterion for participants with poor nutrition or dehydration.

data.name: Hepatic Criteria for Study Intervention Interruption or Discontinuation
data.text: ALT or AST ≥2x baseline or ≥250 U/L (whichever occurs first) and TBL ≥2x ULN or INR ≥1.5 requires study drug interruption/discontinuation with monitoring in participants with elevated baseline hepatic values.

data.name: Discontinuation and Withdrawal for Pregnancy
data.text: Any female participant who becomes pregnant while participating in the study will discontinue study intervention and will be withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Temporary Interruption of Study Intervention
data.text: Temporary interruption of study intervention for gastrointestinal tolerability or for reasons unrelated to gastrointestinal tolerability (Sections 6.6.4 and 7.1.3).

data.name: Blinded Dose Modification via IWRS
data.text: All dose adjustments are managed in a blinded fashion through IWRS.

data.name: Dose Modification for Poor Nutrition or Dehydration
data.text: Dose modification option for participants with poor nutrition or dehydration; management per Section 6.6.2 and Appendix 11 flow chart.

data.name: Dose Reduction for BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or Excessive Weight Reduction
data.text: Dose reduction for BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or perceived excessive weight reduction, with recommendation for monitoring weight after dose reduction.

data.name: Rescue Therapy for Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia
data.text: Rescue therapy may be initiated for severe persistent hyperglycemia (Section 6.9.4); rescue medication and symptomatic medication for gastrointestinal symptoms per Sections 6.9.5 and 6.9.6.

data.name: Concomitant Medication Adjustment or Discontinuation
data.text: Monitor closely and routinely assess the need to adjust or discontinue concomitant medications such as antihypertensive medications, diuretics, lipid-lowering agents, laxatives, and anti-emetics (Sections 6.9.1 and 10.10).

data.name: Transition to Early Discontinuation Visit
data.text: For early discontinuation that occurs before the last visit in the treatment period, perform the activities listed for ED in the SoA.

data.name: Early Discontinuation (ED) Visit
data.description: Early discontinuation occurring before the last visit in the treatment period; ED visit assessments (including fasting labs, ECG, PROs, DID-EQ if discontinuation at or before Week 4) are performed per SoA.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.description: Permanent discontinuation of study intervention per Section 7.1, including hepatic criteria and poor nutrition/dehydration criterion; participants may remain in study for follow-up assessments.

data.name: Participant Withdrawal from Study
data.description: Participant discontinuation/withdrawal from the study per Section 7.2, including mandatory withdrawal for pregnancy.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: Participant lost to follow up per Section 7.3.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Completion of the 40-week treatment period (Visit 11) followed by the safety follow-up visit (Visit 801) approximately 4 weeks after the last treatment period visit, with eDiary return.

data.name: Safety Follow-up Waiver Exit
data.description: Participants who discontinued study intervention early and are only willing to return for Visit 11 (Week 40) exit without a safety follow-up visit if off study intervention for at least 28 days.

data.name: Continued Access After End of Study
data.description: Continued access to study intervention after the end of the study per Section 6.7.

data.name: Visit 2 Eligibility Review Decision
data.description: Review of screening laboratory results and fundus photography at Visit 2 to confirm eligibility before proceeding to randomization

data.name: Randomization Decision at Visit 3
data.description: Confirmation of all inclusion/exclusion criteria and availability of pregnancy test result prior to randomization via IWRS and first dose of study intervention

data.name: Week 24 Ophthalmology Follow-up Decision
data.description: Follow-up fundus photography at Week 24 (±4 weeks) performed only if retinopathy or DME were present at baseline

data.name: PK Sampling Window Assignment Decision
data.description: IWRS assigns one of three post-dose PK sampling windows (1-24 hr, 24-96 hr, or 120-168 hr) at Weeks 7, 15, and 19 PK-only visits

data.name: Hepatic Safety Decision Point
data.description: Assessment of hepatic laboratory values to determine close hepatic monitoring, study intervention interruption, or discontinuation, and whether monitoring frequency can be reduced to every 1 to 2 weeks

data.name: Nutrition/Hydration Management Decision
data.description: Assessment of nutritional and hydration status and BMI to determine dose modification, additional monitoring, or discontinuation per Appendix 11

data.name: Rescue Therapy Decision
data.description: Decision to initiate rescue therapy for severe persistent hyperglycemia based on glycemic assessments

data.name: Early Discontinuation PRO Decision
data.description: DID-EQ administered at the ED visit only if discontinuation is at or before Week 4

data.name: Safety Follow-up Requirement Decision
data.description: Determination of whether the Visit 801 safety follow-up visit is required based on time off study intervention (≥28 days) and participant willingness

data.name: Fasting Visit Rescheduling Decision
data.description: If participant attends a fasting visit non-fasting, reschedule within the allowable visit interval tolerance
